title: DEBT103: A nightly sweep that stops still ends the job with exit 0
note: The daily price job runs `archive sweep --write` after its refresh (D224). A second throttle or a host that refused from the first sku stops the sweep. It keeps every bucket it wrote (D222) and records a failed `archive` step. The job still ends 0, by the owner's default. `#/pricing` draws a step's sentence only when the whole refresh failed, so on the screen a stopped night looks like a finished one.
